description: Find when a person's Saturn returns happen: every date transiting Saturn reaches their birth Saturn degree from age 20 to 95 (often two or three passes per return), their Saturn sign and its approved meaning, and a link to the free Saturn return page. Use when someone asks "when is my Saturn return", "am I in my Saturn return" or "what age is my second Saturn return". The dates are searched in an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, which cannot be done by hand. birth_time and the birthplace are optional; without them the dates use noon and can move by a day or two.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

name: get_saturn_return
title: Saturn return dates
